stream: MLHKP non-Mundarica source census and ingestion
title: Hindi-Mundari Translation Dataset

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: README, TSV, license, copyright file, mirrors and papers describing this release are manifestations/dependencies of one corpus identity unless item-level collation proves otherwise

rights_and_access.redistribution: conditional; exact license text must govern

evidence_promotion.reason: Provider-level metadata verifies corpus existence and structure, but this run does not establish item-level provenance/consent, cultural suitability, deterministic local bytes/SHA-256, or validated translation accuracy. Provider record count is not an MMSC evidence count.

verification_notes: Provider README reports 17,826 Hindi-Mundari sentence pairs in translation-hi-unr.tsv.
Provider README identifies UTF-8 TSV with Hindi first column and Mundari second column.
Provider README labels the release non-commercial and describes BY-NC-SA-FS 1.0 terms.
Do not treat machine-learning use or public GitHub availability as unrestricted cultural-evidence permission.
Do not merge this parallel corpus with the Karya Mundari TTS corpus merely because the organizations and language overlap.
gaps: full license-text legal interpretation for intended release mode
translation validation by qualified Mundari speakers
row-level duplicate and overlap analysis against other corpora
dialect/variety and script characterization at record level
release_effect: source-census expansion only; controlled MMSC/evidence/publication counts unchanged pending deterministic ingestion and reconciliation
